segments.text: Namaskaram, Chief Minister. Good to have you on the show. Ladies and gentlemen, delighted to be here in Kerala by the banks of the… of the sea or by the sea coast with a very special guest. Please join your hands together to give a big welcome to the Kerala Chief Minister, Mr. V.D. Satishan.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: Mr. Satishan, I want to start by… you've now completed over a hundred days, but I want to take you back to the election campaign because you did something when I was following you on the campaign that I have seen very few leaders doing. You claimed when I was interviewing you that the UDF would get not less than one hundred seats. And you looked in the camera and said, I will retire from politics if we don't get a hundred seats.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: Nobody believed you, including me. You ended up with a hundred and two seats. What was it? Where did this conviction come from when no one was giving you hundred seats? Most people were saying, tight contest in Kerala. Is there some… Are you a pollster of sorts that you know exactly what is going to happen?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: When I took over as a leader of opposition in 2021, our situation was very miserable because two consecutive times we lost the elections. All the leaders of UDF and workers were demoralized. Then we started to work.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: in all the by-elections to the local bodies, all the by-elections to the assemblies, we concentrated in each constituency and we did a wonderful social engineering. We learnt things and we had a narrative for everything. Then the parliament election.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: We won 18 out of 20 seats. Almost except one assembly by-election, we won all the by-elections. You know that across the country, the opposition are losing the by-elections. Here, we won almost all the by-elections. Then the local body election is very important in Kerala, highly political. We won. After a few years,
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: After many years, we had a wonderful victory in the local body. So we learned many things. We studied a lot. Then I had a calculation that we will go above 100 seats. But all the surveys across the country, I think 26 surveys,
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Majority surveys predicted that we will lose the elections. That itself was very difficult. At the peak of the election, all the leaders were again demoralized. At the peak of the election one fine morning, I still remember that five channels and surveys found that we are going to lose the election. Then I made a press conference.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Then I said that we will cross 100 definitely and one dozen ministers are going to lose. That may be plus one or minus one. Actually 13 ministers lost their constituency and we crossed 100, 102. Actually my target in my mind
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

So I'll tell you what, you have an alternate career. If you lose your chief ministership, you can join India today as their lead pollster.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: You can take over the task of polling. It's a very difficult task, but you can do polling instead of being Chief Minister for us. I know that you may invite me for such post. That is why I told you that my target was 110, but I could not reach 110. So there is a task before me to reach that 110, my dream target. So I had to be here.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: But I need to ask you this, would you really have retired from politics if you had not got 100 or that was only to boost the confidence of the workers? Of course. You would have really left politics. That was my word to the entire Kerala. I had to keep my word.

segments.text: Credibility is very important factor in politics. When we are saying something, we have to keep that word. segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: in Congress party to become the Chief Minister. I was the... I am not saying that I was the only person deserving to be a Chief Minister. There are more leaders. segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
